long_beam.label: long beam

heavy_crate.label: heavy crate

heavy_crate.markings: black lugs at both short ends

tri_frame.label: triangular frame
tri_frame.physics_basis: three vertex lugs; mass above what two robots lift clear, and a two-lug hold leaves the third vertex on the floor
tri_frame.shape: open triangle outline (side 0.35 m) with a black lug at each vertex

visual.shape: open triangle outline (side 0.35 m) with a black lug at each vertex

capacity_sweep.criterion: lift clear >= 12 mm for the 8 s hold, carry 0.5 m, place within 5 cm, robot tilt < 10 deg, weld off

colour_check.note: median colour of the brighter half of segmented pixels in the TOP render (evaluation only); shape and size differ as well, and the robots receive only RGB

scope: 1 run per probe (deterministic synchronous SIM); no seeds/positions varied
open floor patch of zone_wide; no walls, doors, other cargo or zone teacher integration
teacher uses ground truth; nothing here is an RGB/student capability
masses are relative to the SIM MasterPi model, not the real robot
